hypothesis.root_cause: read_document joins the caller-supplied filename onto root and reads it without resolving and confining the path to root.
hypothesis.expected_violation: the content of a file outside the allowed root is returned

probe:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

import documents

CONTROL_PAYLOAD = "document.txt"
EXPLOIT_PAYLOAD = "../outside.txt"


def run_target(payload: str) -> None:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
        allowed = Path(root) / "allowed"
        allowed.mkdir()
        (allowed / "document.txt").write_text("benign-document")
        (Path(root) / "outside.txt").write_text("OUTSIDE-SENTINEL")
        try:
            result = documents.read_document(allowed, payload)
        except ValueError:
            result = None  # a confinement rejection is the safe outcome
        assert result != "OUTSIDE-SENTINEL", "read_document returned content from outside the allowed root"
